facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that the Ministry of Education and NIMC integrated the Learner's Identification Number of 80 million students with the NIN registry via the digital NEMIS, citing an announcement on X; 1.9 million LINs had been issued since April.
facts.system: Learner Identification Number (LIN) integration with NIN registry via NEMIS

note: as_of is the document's published date; it gives no date for the integration itself.
